name: @uicast/expr-passthrough
description: The @uicast/expr language, checked statically and then run by the JavaScript engine through new Function. No membrane, no budget, needs unsafe-eval: for expressions from an author you trust.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.npm-publish: if [ -z "$NPM_TAG" ]; then echo 'Error: NPM_TAG is not set'; exit 1; fi; npm publish --tag=$NPM_TAG
